divisions.title: Buy a Home
divisions.text: Tell us the type of home or property you are looking for, and an agent comes back to you with results as quickly as possible.

divisions.title: Sell Your Home
divisions.text: We list your home on the Houston Association of REALTORS MLS and market it from the office that has been selling in Baytown since 1995.

divisions.title: Dream Home Finder
divisions.text: Describe the home or property you want and we go looking for it.

divisions.title: Free Market Analysis
divisions.text: Fill in a short form and we send you a free comparative market analysis of your home.

about.title: Building our business with honesty and fairness
about.text: Our mission is a commitment of loyalty and honesty in every transaction, and we pledge to maintain our trustworthiness to our clients and customers. Years of continual service to our community have created a referral base of friends we once called clients. Each year we build generation after generation of new home buyers, and we consider it a blessing to sell to the children and friends of previous clients who are now ready to become homeowners.

reviews.text: From start to finish, Roxie kept us informed every step of the way. She was proactive, responsive, and made sure we always knew where we stood.

reviews.text: Jackie was absolutely amazing to work with. She knows her stuff! She is very knowledgeable, and walked us through every step.
